title: Summer-Fallow
summary: SUMMER-FAL'LOW, noun [See Fallow.] Naked fallow; land lying bare of crops in summer. SUMMER-FAL'LOW, verb transitive To plow and work repeatedly in summer, to prepare for wheat or other crop.
